card.name: "or" before "equivalent" after prednisone
card.fires_on: The word "or" right after prednisone, where "equivalent" or "its equivalent" comes next. Also "any" after "or" in "or any other abacavir-containing product".

modes.label: Prednisone or equivalent
modes.description: "or" after prednisone in steroid dose limits, before "equivalent".
modes.example: an inability to reduce corticosteroid dose to 10 mg or less of prednisone<< or>> equivalent per day within 12 weeks

modes.label: Or any other product
modes.description: "any" after "or" in warnings not to restart abacavir or any other abacavir-containing product.
modes.example: NEVER restart abacavir and lamivudine tablets or<< any>> other abacavir-containing product.

card.writes: It seems to suppress "relevant" and "related" words, so the text continues with "equivalent" or "other" instead.
card.plain: It marks the "or" in "prednisone or equivalent" and the "any" in "or any other abacavir product".
